benchmark.schemaSql: CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE order_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer_id ON orders(customer_id); CREATE INDEX idx_order_items_order_id ON order_items(order_id);

columns.name: category
columns.expression: CASE WHEN row_number % 3 = 0 THEN 'food' ELSE 'stationery' END

title: [パフォーマンスチューニング][確認しよう] 存在確認にはEXISTSを使う
statement:
customers, orders, order_items, products から、food カテゴリの商品を購入したことがある顧客を表示してください。表示する列は customer_name。重複を出さず、名前の昇順で並べます。

必要なのは購入明細ではなく購入の有無なので、EXISTS を使います。

constraints.name: 存在確認
constraints.value: food 商品を購入した注文明細が1件でもある顧客を表示します

constraints.name: 重複なし
constraints.value: 同じ顧客が複数回購入していても1行だけ表示します

starterSql:
SELECT
  customers.name AS customer_name
FROM customers
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM orders
  JOIN order_items
    ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
  JOIN products
    ON products.id = order_items.product_id
  WHERE orders.customer_id = customers.id
    AND products.category = 'food'
)
ORDER BY customers.name ASC;
solutionSql:
SELECT
  customers.name AS customer_name
FROM customers
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM orders
  JOIN order_items
    ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
  JOIN products
    ON products.id = order_items.product_id
  WHERE orders.customer_id = customers.id
    AND products.category = 'food'
)
ORDER BY customers.name ASC;
